text: This solution, Development of Philippine Nationwide Operational Landslide Monitoring and Warning System — DOST–PHIVOLCS Dynaslope Project addresses natural catastrophe in Philippines between Department of Science and Technology (DOST), Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (PHIVOLCS), and Local Government Units (LGUs). The program was implemented in 2018 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
